'''Deadly Outcast Armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]<ref name="Reveal">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240819|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 7.5.1}}</ref> used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[August 19]], [[2024]], as part of a tie-in promotion for the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: The Acolyte|''The Acolyte'']],<ref name="Reveal" /> being directly inspired by [[The Stranger]] and their [[The Stranger's helmet|helmet]] which are featured heavily in the show.<ref name="The Mandalorian">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''</ref>
